services.name: LPG Filling Plant EPC
services.summary: Complete engineering, procurement and construction solutions for LPG filling plants.
services.description: Dingsheng Energy provides complete EPC solutions for LPG filling plants, including plant design, LPG storage systems, filling equipment, piping, electrical and instrumentation systems, installation, testing and commissioning. Solutions are customized according to operating requirements, site conditions and applicable safety standards.

services.name: Autogas Station EPC
services.summary: Design, supply, installation and commissioning of complete LPG autogas stations.
services.description: Dingsheng Energy designs, supplies, installs and commissions complete LPG autogas stations for safe and efficient vehicle refueling. Project scope can include storage tanks, dispensers, pumps, piping, control systems, electrical systems, safety equipment and associated civil and mechanical works.

services.name: Household LPG Reticulation
services.summary: Centralized LPG distribution systems for residential buildings, apartments, villas and housing projects.
services.description: Household LPG reticulation solutions provide centralized LPG distribution for residential properties. Dingsheng Energy designs and installs cylinder banks, manifolds, pressure regulators, piping and associated safety systems according to building layout, expected demand and site requirements.

services.name: Industrial LPG Reticulation
services.summary: Engineered LPG reticulation systems for factories, commercial facilities and high-demand applications.
services.description: Industrial LPG reticulation systems are engineered for factories, commercial facilities, boilers, kitchens, process equipment and other high-demand applications. Each system is designed to support reliable gas supply, controlled operating pressure, operational safety and efficient LPG utilization.

services.name: LPG Pipeline & Skid Systems
services.summary: Engineered LPG pipeline and skid-mounted systems for controlled transfer, pressure regulation and plant integration.
services.description: Dingsheng Energy provides engineering and integration support for LPG pipelines and skid-mounted systems. Solutions can include LPG transfer equipment, pressure regulation, pumps, valves, controls, instrumentation, fabrication, installation, testing and commissioning.

services.name: Engineering Consultancy
services.summary: Technical assessment, design support and engineering consultancy for LPG equipment and infrastructure projects.
services.description: Dingsheng Energy provides technical review, engineering guidance, design support, equipment selection, safety review and project coordination for LPG infrastructure and equipment systems. Consultancy scope is defined according to the project stage and available technical information.

services.name: Machinery Servicing
services.summary: Inspection, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of LPG machinery and equipment.
services.description: Professional servicing covers LPG filling machines, dispensers, pumps, compressors, flowmeters, vaporizers and related equipment. Inspection, diagnosis, maintenance and operational testing help support safe, reliable and efficient equipment operation.
